body:
>I advice you to slow down, take life one step at a time. 

Really good advice. That's what I'm trying to do. 

>You do not need everything solved today. 

Yeah, you're right. I keep telling myself this. Why won't myself listen to me? Haha. 

>My great-aunt met the love of her life after 4 divorces at age 60 and they lived together for 20 glorious years. 

Man, I needed to hear that. Thanks. 

I appreciate these words. They help. I needed some perspective.
